title: Kagamine Rin — Heated Argument〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Street SEKAI
Crase Cafe

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Heya, MEIKO!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hi, Rin. Welcome.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Have you seen Len?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
He hasn't been in yet today.
Are you meeting him here?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah. I thought he'd be here by now.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
You're welcome to have a seat while you wait.
Can I get you something to drink?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Sure! I'll take an iced tea!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: One iced tea, coming right up.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hey, MEIKO?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: What is it?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: How has L—I mean, how has Miku been lately?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Miku? She's been giving Kohane and the others a lot of advice on their singing.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Kohane is one of the sources of feelings for this SEKAI, right?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Yes, she is.
I forgot you haven't been introduced yet.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah, Len and I were still in the middle of that big fight and I was worried I'd run into him if I came to visit.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: So what are Kohane and the others like?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Hehe. They're all very kind.
I get the feeling you have something else you want to ask me, though.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
What?!
H-How did you know?!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
It's written all over your face, Rin.
You want to know how Len was doing while you two were fighting, am I right?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hrng... How do you always know, MEIKO?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: So how was he?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
He wasn't himself for quite a while.
I could tell he was really worried about you the whole time.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Really?!
Can you give me more details?!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Well, every time he would visit, he would start—

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Heya!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Oh. Speak of the devil.
Hello, Len.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh, Len! I've been waiting for you!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Sorry about that!
I got distracted and lost track of time.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: You're always getting distracted!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
So what were you two talking about?
You looked like you were really getting into it.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Well... What do you think, Rin? Do we tell him?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: No way! This is a secret between me and MEIKO!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Well, there you have it. Sorry, Len.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: What?! That's no fair! C'mon!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I'm not telling! You snooze, you lose!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. At times like these, it's probably best to just leave it alone.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Then what the heck was even the point of us making up?!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Ah... Sorry, I didn't mean...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Oh, I-I'm not mad or anything!
I'm big enough to forgive and forget!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hey, Len...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Are you really okay having me as a partner?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Wh-Why would you ask that? Of course I am.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: You're the only partner I want.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: What about you? Are you okay having me?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Yes, I want you as my partner!
I can't imagine having anyone else!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I would never forgive you if you ever said you wanted to stop being partners!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: When you say it like that, it's a little embarrassing. But thanks.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Hehehe. I should be the one thanking you.
I hope we remain partners forever!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Well don't just stand there all day, Len.
Take a seat. What would you like to drink?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I'll have a coffee. Oh, and no milk!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
What? You can drink coffee without any milk?
Wow! You're like a grown-up!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Heh heh heh. Right?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. I'll be right back with your coffee. You two talk amongst yourselves.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Oh, hey. A lot happened while you were gone, Rin. I need to tell you all about Kohane and the others!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah, what are they like?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. It's good to see them back to their regular selves.
